signals.title_or_quote: [Feature] Multi-agent shared inbox with collision detection
signals.why_relevant: Directly asks for shared inbox with collision detection
signals.drafted_reply: The collision detection piece is the trickiest to get right — a simple 'agent is typing' flag isn't enough because it doesn't survive page reloads or dropped connections. A common pattern is a short-lived server-side lock (say, 30-60 seconds) that refreshes while the agent is active and releases on close or timeout, combined with an optimistic UI warning rather than a hard block. For internal notes, storing them in the same thread model with a visibility flag keeps the data model clean and makes note history trivial to render alongside messages. I built replydeck ({APP_URL}), which ships collision detection and assignment out of the box if you ever want a reference implementation or a hosted fallback while this feature lands.

rescore.why: The thread is a feature request explicitly asking for multi-agent shared inbox with collision detection, assignment routing, and internal notes — exactly the core problems replydeck solves, though the context is a WhatsApp CRM repo rather than email.
